title: Little Girl in Dress by Wrought Iron Gate, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length portrait of a young girl standing beside a tall, decorative wrought iron gate on a paved patio. She is dressed in a classic 1950s pinafore-style patterned dress, white ankle socks, and dark Mary Jane shoes. In the background, a palm tree and the silhouette of a mid-century automobile can be seen, hinting at a sunny suburban setting such as California or Florida. The print features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century family snapshots.
